blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine stocks recovered on Wednesday as investors picked up bargains following the previous session’s decline, with gains on Wall Street also supporting sentiment. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) climbed 1.05 percent, or 59.57 points, to close at 5,736.69. READ: Inflation jump drags PSEi down to 5,677 Philstocks Financial Inc. research manager Japhet Tantiangco attributed the rebound to bargain hunting and positive cues from the US market, where lower Treasury yields helped lift stocks. “The positive cues from Wall Street, backed by the decline in US Treasury yields, also helped in today’s session,” Tantiangco said.
